title: Code and data: heterogeneous ensembles for agricultural price forecasting
description: Code and data to reproduce the modelling and statistical analyses of the paper 'Heterogeneous ensembles for agricultural price forecasting: a multi-horizon evaluation across markets with different volatility': weekly apple prices in six Indian markets (2013-2022), rolling-origin evaluation at horizons of 1-8 weeks, forecast combination, pooled learners, and an external check on onion prices.
